name: Survey tile in Virgo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.2 degrees north of the ecliptic in Virgo, imaged by SPHEREx 20 times in 6 visits over 73 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 40 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2026-05-28, at wavelengths from 1.14 to 4.71 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
